adaptations.description: Replaces the upstream heart-rate-derived, wall-clock-aligned grid with one-hour intervals anchored exactly at raw icustays.intime. Hour 0 is (intime, intime+1h], with a partial final interval at discharge.
Returns at most 336 output intervals (hour_index 0 through 335), ending sooner at raw ICU outtime. Null outtime is conservatively capped at 336 intervals.
Retains nullable rolling component scores in *_24hours_raw while preserving upstream COALESCE(component,0) behavior in the reported components and total.
Adds the omitted leading segment to a partial final row so every exported window is exactly (endtime-24h,endtime], and scores only positive vasoactive rates from episodes lasting at least one hour.

preserved_upstream_behavior: Twenty-four pre-ICU internal hourly rows seed the trailing 24-hour windows; only non-negative hour_index rows are exported.
Hourly event intervals use starttime < charttime and endtime >= charttime.
Component scores use the current and 23 preceding hourly rows; a partial final interval additionally uses its exact omitted leading boundary segment.
Urine output accepts an official urine-output-rate window only when uo_tm_24hr is between 22 and 30 hours and scales it to 24 hours.
Arterial blood gases only are used for respiratory SOFA and ventilation status is evaluated at blood-gas charttime.
All earlier selected-stay urine-output rows are staged so the urine-rate LAG predecessor is preserved.
Missing rolling components contribute zero to sofa_hourly_24h; missingness is exported separately.
